scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "yarn dev:shared" "yarn dev:admin-backend" "yarn dev:admin-frontend"
scripts.build:admin-backend: yarn workspace @ommr/shared build && yarn workspace @ommr/admin-backend build
scripts.build:admin-frontend: yarn workspace @ommr/shared build && yarn workspace @ommr/admin-frontend build
